text:
marta (auditor): Quick ask: need a minimal evidence bundle to prove an RBAC edit did not cause KMS decrypts outside expected scope. Window: 2026-08-11T13:10:00Z -> 2026-08-11T13:30:00Z.

jack: Copy. Which binding/service account?

marta (auditor): ServiceAccount infra/replicator, RoleBinding: replicator-write-binding, change at ~13:17.

ravi: Plan: slice kube-apiserver audit for that RoleBinding, export IRSA mapping, CloudTrail Decrypt events for alias/redwood-* in window, and S3 GETs. Produce manifest + 1-line correlation per decrypt.

jack: Commands I'm running:
# RBAC slice
kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector involvedObject.name=replicator-write-binding -o json > k8s_rbac_slice.json
# IRSA map
kubectl get sa --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | {ns: .metadata.namespace, name: .metadata.name, annotations: .metadata.annotations}' > irsa_map.json
# CloudTrail Decrypts
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-08-11T13:10:00Z --end-time 2026-08-11T13:30:00Z --query 'Events[]' > cloudtrail_decrypts.json
# S3 reads (timeboxed)
aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-access-logs --key 2026/08/11/13/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1, s._7, s._10 WHERE s._1 BETWEEN '2026-08-11T13:10:00Z' AND '2026-08-11T13:30:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads.json

ravi: Cross-check: match decrypt.userIdentity.arn to IRSA-mapped role ARN, then join on requestId/x-amz-request-id to S3 reads. If session_creation < 13:17 mark unrelated.

marta (auditor): Bundle should include manifest.txt (checksums + git sha), k8s_rbac_slice.json, irsa_map.json, cloudtrail_decrypts.json, s3_reads.json, correlation_map.txt (one-line per decrypt), redaction_log.txt, extract_cmds.sh.

evidence-bot: Starting export: evidence_6319990000_20260811. Staging to s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/. Presigned link valid 5d.

jack: I see two Decrypts in the window: 13:12 (pre-edit) and 13:19 (post-edit). Captured session ARNs; will attach sts events to prove session issuance time.

ravi: We'll replace full object keys with hashed placeholders and list mappings in redaction_log.txt.

evidence-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/tmp/evidence_6319990000_20260811.zip (presigned https://presigned.example/e/6319990000). manifest sha256: 0a1b2c3d...

marta (auditor): Downloading now. Please mark the 13:19 decrypt as "unrelated" if session_creation < 13:17, otherwise mark "needs forensics" and escalate.

jack: Noted 1: will add one-line rationale per event in correlation_map.txt.

marta (auditor): Thanks all, closing unless I ask for deeper logs.
